acceptanceCriteria: Supervised runs render the current note under the same authority and freshness rules as dispatch, with focused tests and independent review.
Witnesses for items 2-6 are produced with retained evidence, or each is recorded as unsupported with the reason.
The per-tick observation skips terminal tickets, or the decision not to is recorded with a measured cost.
A decision on out-of-argv note delivery is recorded in the spec.
Promotion of ON-V0 delivery is decided by the owner on the retained evidence.
body: The owner accepted #501 on 2026-10-05 with qualification NOT_RUN; V1-0698 completes on that basis. Delivered: ticket note history (ON-V0-008) and opt-in dispatch rendering (ON-V0-011). Owner-deferred or not run, now tracked here: (1) note rendering in supervised runs (not delivered); (2) a live dispatcher run on a real host; (3) a 4096-event history chain; (4) archive export/import of noted tickets; (5) two-process CAS; (6) a live materialization failure and crash witnesses; (7) the remaining ON-V0-010 evidence and promotion of delivery out of experimental; (8) skipping terminal tickets in the per-tick note observation; (9) delivering the note outside argv (for example a file the worker reads) so roles whose hosts use interpreters or {model} argv can carry it; (10) make gate and go test ./... Recorded in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-operator-notes-v0.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-05-issue501-note-history-dispatch.md.
title: Operator notes: supervised-run rendering, remaining ON-V0 witnesses and promotion (issue #501 follow-up)
